## Key facts

- Abliterated = weight-level modification to reduce refusal behavior.
- Uncensored = broader outcome; the method varies.
- Current RouterHub prices often make uncensored entries cheaper than abliterated entries, but not always.
- Qwen 3.8 Max Uncensored is more expensive than standard Qwen 3.8 Max; no Qwen abliterated entry is listed.
- DeepSeek V4 Pro Abliterated is described as an operator-named alias retaining the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash abliterated upstream.
- DeepSeek, GLM and Qwen entries compared here use Chat Completions.
- Prices checked 2026-10-27; confirm live rates and model IDs in the catalogue.
